selection_rationale: Selected Combined (C=10.0) with validation Macro-F1=0.9387. The improvement over the best word-level baseline (Word (C=10.0), Macro-F1=0.9215) is +0.0172, which exceeds the meaningful difference threshold (Delta_min=0.02). Character n-grams (3-5 char_wb) combined with word n-grams (1-2) capture Turkish agglutinative morphology, suffix variations, and informal social media spelling.
